name: agentlink
description: AI coding agent for VS Code with browser remote control

agentlink.terminal.enabled.description: Enable AgentLink terminals on supported local macOS extension hosts when a compatible standalone Node.js runtime is available. User Host Shell tabs run unsandboxed, while built-in agent commands run in isolated workspace sandboxes. Unsupported, remote, or runtime-incompatible hosts keep the native VS Code terminal provider.

agentlink.terminal.nodePath.description: Optional absolute path to a standalone Node.js executable used by the AgentLink sandbox helper. Leave empty to probe Node.js from VS Code's inherited PATH and standard macOS installation locations. Electron is not supported.

inherit.description: Choose whether sandboxed commands start from all host variables, only core variables (HOME, LOGNAME, PATH, SHELL, USER), or none.

ignoreDefaultExcludes.description: When true, inherit names containing KEY, SECRET, or TOKEN. Set false to apply those default exclusions before custom filters.

exclude.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns for inherited variable names to remove.

set.description: Explicit variables inserted after exclusions. Values are part of the command launch binding and are not shown in sandbox metadata.

includeOnly.description: When non-empty, retain only variable names matching these case-insensitive glob patterns after exclusions and explicit values are applied.

useProfile.description: Run through the user's shell profile. This currently fails closed because the attested interactive helper does not yet support profile loading.

agentlink.terminal.environmentPolicy.description: Controls the host environment inherited by sandboxed agent commands. The default matches Codex: inherit all variables, including credential-like names. Helper-reserved proxy, loader, and VS Code IPC variables remain host-controlled.

agentlink.provider.maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum simultaneous streaming model requests per provider, shared by foreground sessions, background agents, maintenance work, and native web tools. Higher values improve parallel throughput but can increase provider rate-limit errors and usage costs.

enumDescriptions: Expose AgentLink's web_search tool, implemented through the selected model provider's hosted web capability.
Do not expose AgentLink's web_search tool. The agent may use ordinary connected MCP tools according to their normal disclosure and mode permissions.
Do not expose AgentLink's web_search tool. This does not disable unrelated MCP tools.
agentlink.webAccess.searchBackend.description: Choose whether AgentLink exposes its native web_search tool. Native provider use can incur additional charges and sends queries to the selected provider. Web results are untrusted model input.

enumDescriptions: Expose AgentLink's web_fetch tool, implemented through the selected model provider's hosted page-access capability.
Do not expose AgentLink's web_fetch tool. The agent may use ordinary connected MCP tools according to their normal disclosure and mode permissions.
Do not expose AgentLink's web_fetch tool. This does not disable unrelated MCP tools.
agentlink.webAccess.fetchBackend.description: Choose whether AgentLink exposes its native web_fetch tool. Native provider use can incur additional charges and sends URLs and fetched content to the selected provider. Web content is untrusted model input.

enumDescriptions: Prefer the provider's cached web index for the lowest latency.
Use the provider's indexed web corpus, which may be fresher than cached results without requiring live retrieval.
Allow live external web retrieval for the freshest results, with potentially higher latency.
agentlink.webAccess.nativeSearchMode.description: External web access mode for provider-native search and fetch transports that support it. The Codex OAuth fast path supports all three modes; other providers may ignore this setting.

agentlink.webAccess.allowedDomains.description: Optional web-domain allowlist. Mutually exclusive with blockedDomains. Resolution fails closed when the selected backend cannot enforce it.

agentlink.webAccess.blockedDomains.description: Optional web-domain denylist. Mutually exclusive with allowedDomains. Resolution fails closed when the selected backend cannot enforce it.

agentlink.webAccess.maxSearchUsesPerTurn.description: Requested maximum hosted search uses per logical turn. Enforced only by backends that support a hard limit; provider-hosted use may incur additional charges.

agentlink.webAccess.maxFetchUsesPerTurn.description: Requested maximum hosted page fetches per logical turn. Enforced only by backends that support a hard limit.

agentlink.webAccess.maxFetchContentToken.description: Requested per-page fetched-content token cap. Enforced only by backends that support it; fetched content remains untrusted external input.

agentlink.webAccess.maxReplayBytesPerTur.description: Maximum private provider replay bytes retained for exact hosted-tool continuation. Oversized replay is discarded rather than truncated and is never exposed in browser or transcript projections.

agentlink.browserGatewayPort.description: Stable localhost port for the shared AgentLink browser gateway helper. Use a fixed value so the remote UI URL is bookmarkable.

agentlink.browserGatewayLanAccess.description: Expose the browser gateway on your LAN so phones and other devices can connect (e.g. http://agentlink.local:<port>). Requires per-device pairing (run /pair in the chat, then enter the code on the new device). When disabled the gateway only accepts loopback connections. AgentLink will restart the shared gateway helper automatically the next time it's used after this setting changes.

agentlink.browserGatewayMdnsName.description: Hostname to advertise over mDNS when LAN access is enabled (resolves as <name>.local on the same network). If the name collides on the network, a short suffix is appended automatically.

enumDescriptions: Use only the legacy browser snapshot/proxy path.
Publish the helper-owned data plane alongside the legacy path while browsers continue using legacy traffic.
Enable helper-owned data-plane publication for browser cutover. Legacy publication remains available during the staged rollout.
agentlink.browserGateway.dataPlane.description: Browser gateway data-plane rollout mode. Defaults to the helper-owned relay client for dogfooding; set this explicitly to off to restore the complete legacy browser snapshot/proxy path, or shadow to dual-publish while browsers remain on legacy traffic.

agentlink.masterBypass.description: Skip ordinary command and file-write approval prompts. Explicit native escalation, outside-path reads, MCP tools, protected paths, and read-only/delegation boundaries still apply. Use with caution.

agentlink.diagnosticDelay.description: Max milliseconds to wait after file save for diagnostics to settle

agentlink.semanticSearchEnabled.description: Enable semantic codebase search via Qdrant vector index. Requires Qdrant running and an OpenAI API key for embeddings.

agentlink.qdrantUrl.description: Qdrant vector database URL for semantic codebase search

agentlink.openaiCompatible.connections.description: Named OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible connections and models for built-in agent chat and browser Ask Agent. Store credentials with AgentLink's secure key commands; never place secrets in this setting.

id.description: Stable connection ID; creates provider ID openai-compatible:<id>.

baseUrl.description: API root URL, normally ending in /v1. AgentLink appends /chat/completions and never follows redirects.

profile.description: Compatibility profile. generic sends only portable fields; openrouter enables verified OpenRouter extensions.

authKey.description: Secret name stored through AgentLink's secure key command. Omit for no-auth local servers.

headers.description: Bounded non-secret static headers. Credential and transport-controlled headers are rejected.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Explicitly allow a stored credential over non-loopback HTTP. HTTPS or loopback HTTP is recommended.

auxiliaryModel.description: Local model ID from this connection used for condense and helper calls. Defaults to the active model.

id.description: Globally unique stable AgentLink model ID; never sent upstream.

agentlink.openaiCompatible.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used by helper-model features (question detection, background-agent summaries). Examples: LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1, OpenAI https://api.openai.com/v1, OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

agentlink.openaiCompatible.model.description: Model id for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave empty to let the server pick (LM Studio uses the loaded model).

agentlink.openaiCompatible.apiKey.description: Optional API key sent as Bearer token. LM Studio ignores it; hosted endpoints (OpenAI, OpenRouter, etc.) require it.

agentlink.openaiCompatible.timeoutMs.description: Max milliseconds to wait for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint before falling back.

enumDescriptions: Use the built-in regex heuristic (no LLM call).
Use the current chat provider's low-tier model (Claude Haiku, gpt-5.6-luna with stable fallback, etc.). Spends your provider quota on every idle turn.
Use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured under agentlink.openaiCompatible.*.
agentlink.questionDetection.mode.description: How to detect whether the agent is asking a question before it idles, and generate answer buttons.

enumDescriptions: Use the background session's own provider (Haiku / gpt-5.6-luna with stable fallback).
Use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured under agentlink.openaiCompatible.*.
Skip the LLM call and show only the inferred phase status.
agentlink.bgSummary.mode.description: How the tiny status string shown for background agents is summarized.

agentlink.background.defaultAgent.description: Default backend for spawn_background_agent. Use native:auto for AgentLink's built-in background routing, or acp:<id> to launch a configured ACP stdio agent from agentlink.background.acpAgents.

agentlink.background.acpAgents.description: ACP-compatible stdio agent subprocesses that can be used as background-agent backends for read-only/review work. Reference an entry with agentlink.background.defaultAgent = acp:<id> or spawn_background_agent provider = acp:<id>.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in routing/debug output. Defaults to id.

command.description: Executable command for the ACP agent subprocess.

args.description: Arguments passed to the ACP agent subprocess.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the ACP agent subprocess. Values are redacted in AgentLink diagnostics.

initTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for ACP process initialization before failing the background spawn.

readonlyOnly.description: Treat this ACP agent as read-only. Write, move, delete, execute, and unknown permission requests are rejected in the MVP.

agentlink.background.maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of background agents running at once. Launches beyond the limit are queued and start as slots free up. Also caps concurrency per root session and per provider.

agentlink.questionDetection.llmEnabled.description: Deprecated: use agentlink.questionDetection.mode instead. When true, mapped to mode="openai".

agentlink.autoIndex.description: Automatically index the codebase on startup when semantic search is enabled.

enumDescriptions: Function/method-level chunks. Efficient with good recall.
Adds statement-level chunks for finer-grained search. ~50% more embeddings.

agentlink.indexExclusions.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from codebase indexing (in addition to .gitignore).

agentlink.recentApprovalTtl.description: Seconds to remember a single-use command approval (run-once / accept). Repeat identical commands within this window are auto-approved. Set to 0 to disable.

enumDescriptions: Every command not covered by an explicit command rule prompts for approval (current behavior).
Auto-approve read-only commands (ls, git status, rg, version checks). Anything that mutates state still prompts.

Also auto-approve workspace-local mutations, project toolchain commands (npm install/test, builds), and unrecognized plain commands. This trusts your project's scripts and tooling to run without per-command review. Destructive, external, privileged, or obfuscated commands always prompt.
agentlink.commandAutoApproveTier.description: Auto-approve agent terminal commands classified at or below this safety tier. Dangerous commands (rm, sudo, git push, network egress, writes outside the workspace, inline interpreter code) always require approval regardless of this setting. Explicit command rules, recent single-use approvals, and masterBypass take precedence.

agentlink.worktreeDirectorySuffix.description: Suffix for the sibling worktree container used by start_worktree_agent when no worktreePath is provided. Default paths are <repo-parent>/<repo-name><suffix>/<sanitized-workstream-name>.

agentlink.agentModel.description: Legacy global fallback model for the built-in agent chat. Use agentlink.modeModelPreferences for mode-specific defaults.

agentlink.modeModelPreferences.description: Default model per chat mode, keyed by mode slug (e.g. code, architect, ask, debug, review). Manually selecting a model in a mode updates that mode's saved preference.

agentlink.modeReasoningEffortPreferences.description: Default thinking level per chat mode, keyed by mode slug. Manually selecting a thinking level in a mode updates that mode's saved preference.

agentlink.agentMaxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per agent response.

agentlink.thinkingBudget.description: Token budget for extended thinking (only used with thinking-capable models like claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-4-6).

agentlink.showThinking.description: Show thinking blocks in the agent chat UI.

agentlink.anthropic.dynamicModelCapabili.description: Fetch Anthropic model list and capabilities (context window, output tokens, reasoning efforts) from the Anthropic API and merge them over the built-in defaults. Refreshes lazily (never on activation) and falls back to the built-in static metadata when offline or the API is unavailable. Disable to use only the built-in static metadata.

agentlink.autoCondense.description: Automatically condense the conversation context when the context window fills up.

agentlink.autoCondenseThreshold.description: Legacy global auto-condense threshold used for migration. New per-model thresholds are stored in agentlink.modelCondenseThresholds.

agentlink.modelCondenseThresholds.description: Per-model auto-condense thresholds keyed by model ID. Models with 1M+ context windows default to 0.7; other models default to 0.9 when no override is stored.

agentlink.writeRules.description: Glob patterns for files that are always auto-approved for writes without showing a diff view. Supports workspace-relative paths (e.g. "**/*.test.ts") and absolute paths (e.g. "/tmp/**").

agentlink.defaultMode.description: Default mode for new agent chat sessions.

agentlink.codexStatefulResponses.description: Enable OpenAI Responses chaining for Codex/API-key sessions using previous_response_id when available. When a prior response cannot be resumed, AgentLink falls back to full local replay for that turn.

agentlink.codexStoreResponses.description: When Codex stateful responses are enabled, also set store=true on OpenAI Responses requests so server-side response state can be retained. Disabled by default to preserve existing retention behavior.

agentlink.codexProMode.description: Use GPT-5.6 Pro reasoning mode on public OpenAI API-key requests. Pro mode prioritizes reliability over latency and token usage and is not sent to the ChatGPT/Codex OAuth backend or other models.

scripts.lint: bash -c 'e=0; oxfmt --check || e=1; tsc --noEmit || e=1; tsc -p src/agent/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit || e=1; tsc -p src/sidebar/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit || e=1; tsc -p src/approvals/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit || e=1; tsc -p src/browser-gateway/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit || e=1; tsc -p src/terminal/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit || e=1; oxlint src/ --import-plugin --report-unused-disable-directives --deny-warnings || e=1; exit $e'
